name: Create Task
description: This endpoint allows you to create a new task related to the incident or request specified in the URL.

action_type_id.description: Action type ID (tenant-specific); provide at least one of action_type_id or action_type_name
action_type_id.title: Action Type Id

action_type_name.description: Action type name, in the REST API user language; provide at least one of action_type_id or action_type_name
action_type_name.title: Action Type Name

group_id.description: Assigned group ID; provide at least one of group_id, group_name or group_mail
group_id.title: Group Id

group_name.description: Assigned group name; provide at least one of group_id, group_name or group_mail
group_name.title: Group Name

group_mail.description: Assigned group email; provide at least one of group_id, group_name or group_mail
group_mail.title: Group Mail

href.description: URL returned by the API (HREF); may reference /actions/{rfc_number}
